topics.note: Retains stock-v0.28.0 MTP as the configured candidate, but narrows the conclusion: vLLM source supports the Gemma 4 MTP path while this exact Unsloth target/Google assistant pair remains locally unmeasured. Expands PR #41703 from two Gemma fixes to its current five-part fix set.

topics.topic: Selected deployment and implemented launch profile
topics.note: Revalidated against services/llama-swap-vllm/config.yaml. The target, image digest, 262144-token limit, 0.9 memory budget, FP8 KV cache, prefix caching, Gemma parsers, MTP assistant, K=4, max-num-seqs=128, and singleton routing are configured state only, not runtime proof.

topics.topic: MTP tuning note and speculative-depth sweeps
topics.section: The measurement that changes the decision
topics.note: Preserves the proposed MTP sweep at K=2,4,7,8 and the requirement to change one variable per arm. The B300 K=7 result remains external historical evidence, not a prediction for the local RTX PRO 5000 or Unsloth export.

The current DFlash card still requires open PR #41703. The PR now covers embedding normalization, final-logit soft-capping, concrete KV geometry, rejected-token handling, and a text-only draft-backend fix. Its published vLLM point uses 15 speculative tokens; K=7 remains only one proposed sweep point.

topics.topic: Stages 1-3: correctness, behavior preservation, and depth tuning
topics.section: The measurement that changes the decision
topics.note: Preserves exact greedy-output parity, tool-call validity, stability, prefix-cache, latency, throughput, acceptance, and task-success acceptance criteria, including concurrency 17 as a padded-batch regression probe.

topics.topic: Stages 4-7: context, cache, residency, modalities, scheduler, and graphs
topics.section: Tradeoffs are coupled but evidence is separate
topics.note: Preserves the full-context capacity gate, FP8-KV and prefix-cache controls, singleton-residency requirement, text-only canary, and one-knob-per-arm rule. No historical proposal is presented as an observed local result.

Removes the unsupported expectation that target plus assistant fits at 262144 tokens inside the 0.9 budget. The briefing requires startup profiling to prove one full-length slot after weights, multimodal components, KV cache, and CUDA graphs.
Condenses the sequence to a target-only control, the configured K=4 MTP arm, then depth and context canaries only after correctness and stability pass.
